Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology. About the team: CST Team comprises service associates who help customers get onboarded on Paytm and help them have a good experience of Paytm services. About the role: Candidate has to handle concerns and complaints raised by the customers/merchants on a day-to-day basis and make sure the daily tasks are being closed within the defined TAT with a good customer experience.
